mount.none.name: On foot
mount.none.blurb: Wilbur Hay says walking builds character, then adds, quietly, that so does arriving before dark.
mount.barley-pack-mule.name: Barley the Pack Mule
mount.barley-pack-mule.blurb: Wilbur will swear on the stable ledger that Barley has never once bolted, spooked or hurried, and considers all three a selling point.
mount.dappled-courser.name: Dappled Courser
mount.dappled-courser.blurb: Brushed twice daily, renamed eleven times, and quietly faster than anything else Wilbur is willing to rent to a stranger.
mount.bastion-warhorse.name: Bastion Warhorse
mount.bastion-warhorse.blurb: Bred for a war nobody got round to holding, so he runs errands instead and is visibly overqualified for every one of them.
mount.ember-drake.name: Ember Drake
mount.ember-drake.blurb: Wilbur keeps this stall at the far end of the yard, downwind, with two buckets of sand and an expression of enormous calm.
